name: signature-vector
why: The canonical request is the one thing no response fixture can check. Both sides build it independently, so a divergence in the separator or the field order leaves every test green on each side and fails every real call. This pins it with an arithmetic answer.

canonicalForm.note: The body is signed exactly as transmitted. Re-serialising it before signing or before verifying compares a normalised form against a signature taken over the original.
